integrity: The all-n mathematics is proved analytically; 105 exact rational finite verifications and twenty numerical root checks are supplemental. Full text was inspected for the closest Dirichlet result and for the published general resolvent criterion; independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Symmetric unit-weight path Laplacian with reflecting (cell-centered no-flux) boundaries only; no variable weights, Robin boundary data, other Neumann stencils, nonlinear invariance, or accuracy assertion for large steps. A relevant Neumann specialist paper was not available in full.
title: Sharp positivity thresholds for Crank–Nicolson on reflecting paths
